#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
d=$1
shift
export DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode_26.6.app/Contents/Developer
export SDKROOT="$DEVELOPER_DIR/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX26.5.sdk"
export TMPDIR="$d/work/tmp" CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH="$d/clang-cache" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$d/xdg-cache"
export SWIFTPM_MODULECACHE_OVERRIDE="$CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH"
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=file GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
for pair in '0 swift-crypto-7e0614ea swift-crypto' '1 swift-asn1-7065ad2c swift-asn1'; do
    read -r i cached name <<< "$pair"
    export "GIT_CONFIG_KEY_$i=url.file://$HOME/Library/Caches/org.swift.swiftpm/repositories/$cached.insteadOf"
    export "GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_$i=https://github.com/apple/$name.git"
done
swift="$HOME/Library/Developer/Toolchains/swift-6.3.3-RELEASE.xctoolchain/usr/bin/swift"
exec /usr/bin/sandbox-exec -p '(version 1) (allow default) (deny network-outbound (remote ip))' \
"$swift" build --disable-sandbox --package-path "$d/work/relocated/Platforms/Android" \
--scratch-path "$d/swift-build" --cache-path "$d/swift-cache" --config-path "$d/swift-config" \
--security-path "$d/swift-security" --manifest-cache local --disable-dependency-cache \
--disable-prefetching --disable-index-store --swift-sdks-path "$HOME/Library/org.swift.swiftpm/swift-sdks" \
--swift-sdk aarch64-unknown-linux-android28 --force-resolved-versions -j 8 --product AppAndroid \
-Xswiftc -gnone -Xcc -g0 -Xlinker -z -Xlinker max-page-size=16384 "$@"
reconstructionAndBuild.native-inputs.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
d=$1
stage=$2
revision=$3
out="$d/native"
mkdir -p "$out" "$out/source"
export TMPDIR="$out" CARGO_HOME="$out/cargo"
export PATH="$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.0-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin:$PATH"
export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=file
ndk="$HOME/Library/org.swift.swiftpm/swift-sdks/swift-6.3.3-RELEASE_android.artifactbundle/swift-android/android-ndk-r27d/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/darwin-x86_64/bin"
export CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_LINUX_ANDROID_LINKER="$ndk/aarch64-linux-android28-clang"
git -C "$stage" archive "$revision" vm native/android/signed-guest-ui verification/android-binding-stage4/host-bridge | tar -x -C "$out/source"
binding="$out/source/native/android/signed-guest-ui/binding/include"
transport="$out/source/native/android/signed-guest-ui/transport"
host="$out/source/verification/android-binding-stage4/host-bridge"
bridge="$d/work/fieldlog/Integrations/GeneratedReport/Platforms/Android/Bridge"
"$CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_LINUX_ANDROID_LINKER" --version
rustc --version
for source in "$transport/transport.c" "$transport/platform_android.c" "$bridge/ChecklistBridge.c"; do
  name=$(basename "$source" .c)
  "$CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_LINUX_ANDROID_LINKER" -fPIC -std=gnu11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 \
    -I"$binding" -I"$host" -c "$source" -o "$out/$name.o"
  shasum -a 256 "$source" "$out/$name.o"
done
cargo build --manifest-path "$out/source/vm/Cargo.toml" --offline --locked --release --jobs 4 \
    --features experimental-capability-native --lib --target-dir "$out/rust-build" --target aarch64-linux-android
ln -s "$out/rust-build/aarch64-linux-android/release/libmixer_vm.a" "$out/libmixer_vm_capability_experimental.a"
shasum -a 256 "$out/libmixer_vm_capability_experimental.a"
reconstructionAndBuild.link-jni.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
d=$1
ndk="$HOME/Library/org.swift.swiftpm/swift-sdks/swift-6.3.3-RELEASE_android.artifactbundle/swift-android/android-ndk-r27d/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/darwin-x86_64/bin"
r="$d/work/relocated"
bin="$d/swift-build/aarch64-unknown-linux-android28/debug"
signed="$d/evidence/signed"
mkdir "$signed"
cp "$bin/description.json" "$bin/AppAndroid.product/Objects.LinkFileList" "$signed/"
cp "$bin/libAppAndroid.so" "$signed/"
export TMPDIR="$d/work/tmp"
shasum -a 256 "$r/Platforms/Android/Bridge/PublicBridge.c"
for label in baseline signed; do
  dir="$d/evidence/$label"
  "$ndk/aarch64-linux-android28-clang" -shared -fPIC -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
    "$r/Platforms/Android/Bridge/PublicBridge.c" -L "$dir" -lAppAndroid \
    -Wl,--no-undefined -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384 -o "$dir/libmixer_public_android_jni.so"
  "$ndk/llvm-readelf" -h -d -l "$dir/libmixer_public_android_jni.so" > "$dir/jni-readelf.txt"
  "$ndk/llvm-nm" --dynamic --defined-only "$dir/libmixer_public_android_jni.so" > "$dir/jni-nm.txt"
  "$ndk/llvm-nm" --dynamic --undefined-only "$dir/libmixer_public_android_jni.so" > "$dir/jni-undefined.txt"
  "$ndk/llvm-readelf" -h -d -l "$dir/libAppAndroid.so" > "$dir/app-readelf.txt"
  "$ndk/llvm-nm" --dynamic --defined-only "$dir/libAppAndroid.so" > "$dir/app-nm.txt"
done
